page_title: INT 2-1 VER | Inter v Verona 06/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+10' Thomas Henry (Verona) fails to convert the penalty kick! His effort hits the left post.
90+9' Thomas Henry (Verona) is going to take the penalty!
90+9' The Verona players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
90+8' There's a break in play and referee Michael Fabbri must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Verona using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+5' That was really pointless. Darko Lazovic (Verona) was being offensive and couldn't control himself. He gave Michael Fabbri no choice but to send him off.
90+4' Referee Michael Fabbri points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Inter players celebrate.
90+3' Wait! The referee has now indicated he wants to check if the goal for Inter can stand using VAR.
90+3' 2 - 1 Goal! Davide Frattesi (Inter) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
90+3' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the crossbar! A few inches lower and it could have been a sweet goal!
90+2' Inter have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+1' Substitution. Tomas Suslov will be replaced by Charlys (Verona).
90' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the right post! What a huge opportunity!
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
87' That's the end of the game for Cyril Ngonge, who is replaced by Yayah Kallon (Verona).
86' Inter keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
83' Simone Inzaghi has decided to substitute Henrikh Mkhitaryan and he is replaced by Davide Frattesi (Inter).
83' Substitution. Benjamin Pavard did his best and is replaced by Alexis Sanchez (Inter).

82' What a save from Lorenzo Montipo! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
78' Tomas Suslov (Verona) picks up a yellow card.
77' Diego Coppola (Verona) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Michael Fabbri ignores the protests.
74' 1 - 1 Thomas Henry (Verona) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
73' Substitution. Marko Arnautovic (Inter) replaces Marcus Thuram.
73' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Josh Doig will be replaced by Juan David Cabal (Verona).
73' The manager makes a subsitution with Thomas Henry (Verona) coming on for Milan Djuric.
72' Here is a change. Carlos Augusto is going off and Simone Inzaghi gives the last tactical orders to Federico Dimarco (Inter).
72' Darko Lazovic (Verona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Yann Sommer, who smothers the ball.
70' Michael Fabbri interrupts the game. One of the players from Verona won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
68' Inter can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
66' Lautaro Martinez plays the ball through to Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) on the edge of the box, he turns and shoots but it's a fraction wide of the left post.
66' Tomas Suslov (Verona) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
61' Here comes a substitution. Denzel Dumfries is given a rest as he is replaced by Matteo Darmian (Inter).
61' A player from Inter commits a rough challenge. Michael Fabbri blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
59' Marcus Thuram (Inter) gets on the end of a nice cross, but places his close-range header well wide of the left post.
57' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Lorenzo Montipo easily deals with the threat.
55' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Inter was in an offside position.
54' Milan Djuric (Verona) receives a cross in the box and attempts to shoot, but mishits the ball and misses the goal.
52' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
50' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Inter due to an offside in the build-up play.
49' Wait! Referee Michael Fabbri has indicated he is going to review the Inter goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
49' Goal! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:0.
48' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Inter.
47' Darko Lazovic (Verona) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Jordi Mboula (Verona) is replaced by Darko Lazovic.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Tomas Suslov (Verona) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
42' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle after Lautaro Martinez (Inter) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
41' A pass by Carlos Augusto (Inter) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
40' Inter are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
38' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
37' Verona concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
36' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
34' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but Lorenzo Montipo comes off his line to gather the ball.
33' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
31' A player from Inter commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
28' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post.
27' Nice touch by Milan Djuric (Verona) as he latched on to an accurate cross and attempted to direct the ball with a fine header towards the net, but the goalkeeper reacted quickly to keep it out.
25' Handball! A player from Verona handled the ball.
23' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.

23' Play continues despite the shouts by some Inter players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Michael Fabbri interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
22' Surely that's handball by one of the Verona players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
22' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
22' Inter are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
21' The referee blows his whistle as Michael Folorunsho (Verona) was too aggressive in his challenge.
17' The resulting set piece from Inter is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
13' 1 - 0 Lautaro Martinez (Inter) collects a killer pass and fires a low shot into the middle of the net, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
12' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Michael Fabbri blows for a foul.
12' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
9' A corner kick by Inter is thwarted by the well prepared Lorenzo Montipo (Verona).

9' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. Inter have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
8' Inter take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
7' One of the Verona players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
4' Ondrej Duda (Verona) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
3' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
2' Carlos Augusto (Inter) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
1' The Inter players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Verona will kick-off.
Michael Fabbri will referee today's match.
